label: Space Stations → TAK
info:
Live positions of crewed space stations (ISS, Tiangong) and related objects.

Data: Space-Track.org and SatNOGS DB (https://www.space-track.org/). Updates every 30 seconds (orbits refreshed every 6 hours).

Needs: A free [Space-Track.org](https://www.space-track.org/auth/createAccount) account; The satellite.js module (see *Satellite and GOES flows* in the main README).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Set SPACETRACK_USER and SPACETRACK_PASS in the tab's Environment Variables (keep the password type as *credential*).
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/space-stations
